title: Operator Administration Without SQL
objective: Authorized Oxford Lancers administrators can provision and manage application operators and their predefined role assignments through the application without requiring Brian to run SQL or make ordinary account changes directly in Supabase.
why_now: The authorization substrate, login and password recovery exist, but the hosted role catalogue and recurring operator-administration workflow are not available through the application. The approved Release 1 manifest marks Identity, Access and Operator Administration ready for intake, while current operation still depends on direct database changes.
non_goals: No runtime creation, renaming or editing of club roles or capability grants; the approved static 20-role catalogue includes the fixed coaching hierarchy
No wider H7 ownership and access completion sweep
No LAN-84 production recovery rehearsal or two-service-administrator establishment
No Meta, WhatsApp, DNS, Resend, SMTP, email-foundation or real-data cutover work
No player-facing accounts or public sign-up
No authentication-architecture redesign or operator two-factor authentication
No general People/roster redesign beyond the minimum duplicate-checked create-or-link Person seam required to invite an operator
No coach module, coach self-service football workflow, expanded coach data visibility or unapproved coach capability grants; this mission includes coach account onboarding only
No special bulk handover mode or general cycle-open/close implementation
No full Stage-4 general change-audit browser, cross-system search, filtering, export or investigation interface; the bounded per-operator Access History is included
No Mission Lead DAG, worker assignment, detailed work package or implementation sequencing in this packet
No mission execution before Brian merges a ready packet version

requirements.text: The application uses the approved static 20-role catalogue: ten committee/operational roles plus the fixed ten-role coaching hierarchy. The catalogue is available in hosted and local environments through versioned, reviewable repository artifacts, visually grouped by role family, and cannot be edited in the application.

Every operator-administration read and write is enforced at the server/service boundary by role_management plus target-level leadership guards. President, General Manager and IT Officer hold role_management. Vice-President and Secretary retain broad ordinary operating capabilities but cannot administer accounts or role assignments. IT Officer is transitional technical administration and may not remove President or General Manager through the ordinary workflow.

The operator shell contains Operators and Roles destinations at /operate/admin/operators and /operate/admin/roles in Administration at the bottom of the left sidebar immediately above user/account controls. Roles are grouped into committee/operational and coaching sections and show current holders plus a read-only plain-language capability summary. No role or grant is editable.

An authorized administrator first searches and duplicate-checks for a durable Person. If found, the workflow links that Person; if absent, it creates a minimal Person without player membership using given name and an available contact point. A valid personal email is required before operator invitation. The workflow then creates and binds the operator login one-to-one, optionally assigns approved roles in the active operating year, and emails a secure invitation. Public sign-up remains disabled.

The workflow represents Invited, Active, Deactivated and Reinstated states, treats expiration as a normal state, permits resend while Invited, and refuses duplicate Person bindings or duplicate emails with an actionable reason.

The first version presents one active operating-year context, such as 2026-27, for routine committee and season assignments. The form visibly confirms that context and stores the applicable cycle identifier explicitly without requiring a repetitive cycle dropdown. A different or future year requires an intentional context switch; missing, closed or ambiguous cycles are refused.

Ordinary roles are assigned into the active operating year with an effective-from date and normally no manual effective-to. Ending or replacing sets effective-to and creates the successor assignment without deleting history. The single-holder General Manager role is standing across operating years and has no automatic cycle-end expiry.

An authorized administrator can deactivate an operator with a required reason and date, and reinstate the same Person-account binding later. Deactivation immediately prevents sign-in and never deletes the Person, account binding, attribution or historical records.

For lost email access, an authorized administrator can re-home an operator login to a new email, disable the old login path, and preserve audited attribution on both sides. Forgotten-password recovery remains self-service and is not replaced by administrator password handling.

No operator may deactivate themselves or end/remove their own role assignment. General Manager may end/replace or deactivate President; President may not end/replace or deactivate General Manager; IT Officer may not remove either leadership role through the ordinary workflow. President and General Manager may administer Vice-President, Secretary, IT Officer, coaches and other lower roles. No action may eliminate every usable administration path.

Every provisioning, account-state, email-rehome and role-assignment change writes append-only audit evidence atomically, naming actor, target, time and before/after state. Operator detail includes a read-only Access History for these mission-owned events. The later full Stage-4 general audit browser remains excluded.

Exactly one owner-run bootstrap may establish the hosted role catalogue and first administrator-capable operator. It is reviewable, fail-closed, documented and audited. After bootstrap, every ordinary identity, access and role action is completed in the application; a second SQL-based administration touch is a defect.

A short club-facing guide explains create-or-link Person, coach and committee invitation, first login, active-year context, role assignment/replacement, leadership safeguards, Access History, deactivation/reinstatement and email re-home. It contains no SQL, Supabase-dashboard or WhatsApp-authentication procedure.

Implementation and verification do not alter hosted accounts, production data, secrets, email/DNS configuration or recovery ownership autonomously. Any migration or one-time hosted bootstrap remains an explicit Brian-run handoff under existing runbooks.

President, General Manager and IT Officer may assign people to the approved static catalogue, including roles that currently carry no privileged capabilities. They cannot create roles or edit grants in the application. The Roles page provides read-only capability transparency; any new role or grant change remains a separately reviewed owner decision and code change.

Administration visually separates the fixed coaching hierarchy and supports create-or-link Person, secure email invitation and year-scoped role assignment for every coach role. Coaches never require player membership. HC/OC/DC retain the approved narrow attendance capability; position-coach accounts receive no unapproved coach-module or administrative access.

Operator invitations and password recovery use Supabase Auth secure email links delivered through the provider-neutral transactional email path, currently Resend/custom SMTP under LAN-126. Administrators never choose or send passwords, and WhatsApp is not used for authentication.

decisions.text: No split. Provisioning, operator lifecycle, role assignment, current-state surfaces, safeguards and the short operating guide form one coherent commissioned outcome.
decisions.source: Commissioned outcome and Mission Intake Agent rare-splitting rule

repository_drift.startup_rule: The Mission Lead must compare current main to the baseline and run the canonical Harness drift checks before planning or dispatch. A newer main is acceptable only when the packet's meaning, feasibility, invariants, interfaces and acceptance basis remain intact.
repository_drift.stop_rule: Stop for re-intake or a versioned packet revision when drift changes authorization, operator/account/role schema semantics, audit guarantees, route placement, security boundaries or acceptance evidence.

workflow_matrix.actor: Active President, General Manager or IT Officer, subject to target-level leadership guards
workflow_matrix.trigger: Needs to inspect or manage operator access
workflow_matrix.entry_point: Administration at the bottom of the operator shell left sidebar
actions: View current operators and account states
View committee/operational roles and the coaching hierarchy
Read current holders and plain-language capability summaries
Open an operator or role detail
Read bounded Access History when viewing an operator
handoffs: Choose the account-side or role-side path for the same audited assignment action
exceptions: Vice-President, Secretary and all other roles cannot read operator-administration data or invoke its actions
No operators shows the empty state with Invite
Role and capability definitions are always read-only
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Current account status, effective roles, cycle scope and current holders are understandable without SQL

workflow_matrix.actor: Active President, General Manager or IT Officer, subject to target-level leadership guards
workflow_matrix.trigger: An existing Person needs application access
actions: Search and duplicate-check for an existing Person
Link the existing Person or create the minimum durable Person without player membership
Assign approved initial role in the visible active operating year
state_transitions: Invited to Active after first sign-in/password setup
exceptions: Possible duplicate requires deliberate link or merge handling
Transactional-email failure is visible and retryable
No password is chosen or transmitted by the administrator
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: A durable Person exists without requiring the invitee to log in, is bound one-to-one to an invited operator account, receives a secure email link, and holds only the approved effective role authority

workflow_matrix.actor: Active President, General Manager or IT Officer, subject to target-level leadership guards
workflow_matrix.trigger: A predefined office or coaching seat changes holder
actions: Choose one role from the static committee/operational or coaching catalogue
Confirm the displayed active operating year
Assign with no routine end date
End with effective-to when reality changes
Use replacement to preserve the outgoing assignment and create the successor
state_transitions: Ended assignment plus new effective assignment
handoffs: The same service action is invoked from either direction
exceptions: Closed, missing or ambiguous active year
Role/cycle scope mismatch in stored state
Person would hold two constitutional offices
President attempts to remove General Manager
IT Officer attempts to remove President or General Manager
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Current assignment changes immediately while prior effective-dated facts remain durable

workflow_matrix.actor: Active President, General Manager or IT Officer, subject to target-level leadership guards
workflow_matrix.trigger: An operator leaves, loses access or returns
handoffs: Deactivated person remains resolvable to historical records
exceptions: IT Officer cannot deactivate President or General Manager
No action may eliminate every usable administration path
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Sign-in access ends or resumes without deleting the Person, binding or history

workflow_matrix.actor: Active President, General Manager or IT Officer, subject to target-level leadership guards
workflow_matrix.trigger: An operator permanently loses access to the current email address
state_transitions: Same operator binding reachable at new email
handoffs: Operator signs in or recovers password using the new email
exceptions: Ordinary forgotten password routes to self-service recovery
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Access is restored without changing the durable Person or historical actor attribution

workflow_matrix.actor: System on behalf of the authorized administrator
workflow_matrix.trigger: Any mission-owned provisioning or role transition succeeds
workflow_matrix.placement: Read-only Access History on operator detail; no general audit-browser route
actions: Commit audit and state change atomically
Render mission-owned events in the operator's read-only Access History
state_transitions: Append one immutable audit event; never edit or delete prior evidence
handoffs: Evidence is available to later Stage-4 audit-view work
exceptions: A failed/refused action writes no partial state
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: President, General Manager and IT Officer can review who changed an operator's access and when; the full cross-system audit explorer remains deferred

workflow_matrix.actor: President, General Manager or IT Officer with an effective role_management grant
workflow_matrix.trigger: Attempt to open or use administration surfaces
workflow_matrix.entry_point: Every administration page, action and service call
actions: Protect self, General Manager and President transitions as specified
exceptions: IT Officer targets President or General Manager
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: President, General Manager and IT Officer may perform ordinary access administration, while leadership transitions follow the explicit GM-over-President hierarchy and every other role is refused without operator data

workflow_matrix.actor: Active President, General Manager or IT Officer
workflow_matrix.trigger: A Head Coach, coordinator or position coach joins the active operating year
workflow_matrix.entry_point: Invite in Administration, with the coaching role group selected
actions: Search and duplicate-check for the coach Person
Create a minimal Person without player membership when absent
Assign one or more approved coaching roles for the active operating year
state_transitions: No Person to durable non-player Person when needed
Invited to Active after secure first login
handoffs: Coach receives email and establishes password
Current capability map determines the resulting least-privilege surface
exceptions: Role outside the fixed coaching hierarchy
Position coach receives no deferred coach-module capability
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: The coach is represented as a durable Person and operator with the correct year-scoped coaching role, without appearing on the player roster or gaining unapproved access

nonblocking_unknowns.handling: Do not absorb DNS, Resend or SMTP work. Use Supabase Auth's provider-neutral secure email-link path, prove behavior locally, surface delivery failure and treat production delivery as an external operational gate.

nonblocking_unknowns.unknown: Cycle open/close administration is not yet implemented.
nonblocking_unknowns.handling: Use the one visible active operating-year context already present. Refuse missing or closed context; creating or closing years remains season-lifecycle scope.

nonblocking_unknowns.unknown: The approved fixed coaching hierarchy and football vocabulary retain the localized HC/OC/DC validation gate.
nonblocking_unknowns.handling: Provision the approved role vocabulary as the current authoritative candidate set. If coach validation changes the role list or hierarchy, stop for the dated forward correction and packet drift review; do not invent replacements.
